entry.title: New: Resolution 357 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO RECYCLE HAWAI‘I FOR THE VOLCANO RENAISSANCE FAIRE

Transfers $3,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 5)
